data.lookDescription: Slim young man in modern Tracht: slicked-back medium brown hair with a slight sheen, round panto glasses with tortoiseshell frames and light blue-lilac lenses, big grin. White stand-up collar shirt, grey-lilac damask vest with olive piping, open charcoal loden Janker with a forest-green collar and five cream horn buttons. Tan suede lederhosen with green vine embroidery, white ankle socks, white sneakers with navy heel tabs.
